mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is low, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show negative 20-day returns when UNRATE increases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth combined with high inflation may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show negative 60-day returns when both GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL are above their averages, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates in a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show negative 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is high, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 5-day returns when UNRATE is low, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns when RSAFS increases, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production but falling housing starts may indicate supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 2% year-over-year and HOUST decreases > 5% year-over-year
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show negative 60-day returns when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Significant employment growth in a post-shock recovery signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns when PAYEMS increases, this hypothesis is falsified.
